resources.string: Build a room-by-room estimate. Service pricing, units, and rates are pulled from the saved Price Book and remain editable on each estimate.
Start a new estimate with a blank workspace.
Estimates saved on this device appear here.
For multiple bedrooms, select Bedroom once for each bedroom.
Choose the area type. Measurements and pricing units follow the selected service and Price Book.
One combined material list for every room in this estimate.
Choose services and enter measurements to calculate materials.
Accuracy check: unknown conditions, unverified dimensions, structural work, and concealed damage should be verified on site before final pricing.
THDR Price Book v3.0 · Fully editable service catalog and subcategories · labor-focused estimating database.
Rates shown are THDR working benchmarks normalized to the $85/hour labor rate. Materials, equipment, permits, and subcontractors are not automatically included.
Consolidated project takeoff — drywall tape is estimated at 24 LF per 4x8 sheet, using the combined sheet count.
Quantity calculators based on the Construction Materials Formulas Reference Guide. Results remain separate until added to project materials.
Quantities are planning estimates. Verify dimensions, structural details, product specifications, actual coverage, and site conditions before ordering.
